title: Effect of the spraying process on the microstructure and tribological properties of bronze–alumina composite coatings
InformationInFigures: Yes. Powder morphology in Fig. 1, microstructure in Fig. 4, 5, and 6

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Chemical_Composition: 89 wt% Cu, 10 wt% Al, and 1 wt% Fe
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: bronze powder had a mostly spherical morphology with some satellite particles, alumina had an irregular shape with flat edges.
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Production_Method: aluminum bronze was manufactured by atomization
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: cleaned and grit blasted with Al2O3

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: The dense microstructure in CGS coatings results from the accumulative effect of tamping on the top porous region by the successive impact of following particles
